reason: A client-side DSH Web UI plugin that provides a floating right-side index for user messages, with previews, click-to-scroll navigation, and scroll-position highlighting.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的长对话提供右侧悬浮输入目录，支持消息预览、点击定位和滚动高亮。
summaries.en: Adds a floating right-side index for user messages in DSH Web UI, with previews, click-to-scroll navigation, and scroll-position highlighting.

capabilities: Reads user-message metadata from the active chat session
Displays a floating index rail with message previews
Scrolls the chat view to a selected user message
Tracks the message near the viewport top for highlighting
